title_en: Master Student · SJTU School of Medicine · AI4Rad Lab
title_cn: 硕士研究生 · 交大医学院 · AI4Rad Lab
bio_en: Master student at SJTU School of Medicine and a member of AI4Rad Lab. Research focuses on clinical radiology and medical imaging AI.
bio_cn: 交大医学院硕士研究生，AI4Rad Lab 成员。研究方向为临床放射学与医学影像人工智能。

news_en.text: AbdomenNet — a foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on non-contrast CT, detecting 11 conditions and raising radiologists' mean AUROC from 0.812 to 0.924 — published in Nature Communications (IF 18.1).
Imaging-Grounded Stroke MLLM — a multi-agent multimodal LLM framework for imaging-grounded treatment recommendation in acute ischemic stroke — published in npj Digital Medicine (IF 18.0).
HR-LLM-Stroke — a multi-agent LLM framework for emergency stroke treatment recommendation — published in Journal of Medical Internet Research (IF 8.2).

news_cn.text: AbdomenNet —— 面向非增强 CT 急腹症诊断分层与分诊的基础模型，可检测 11 种急腹症并将放射科医生平均 AUROC 从 0.812 提升至 0.924，发表于 Nature Communications（IF 18.1）。
影像驱动卒中 MLLM —— 面向急性缺血性卒中影像驱动治疗推荐的多智能体多模态大语言模型框架，发表于 npj Digital Medicine（IF 18.0）。
HR-LLM-Stroke —— 面向急诊卒中治疗推荐的多智能体大语言模型框架，发表于 Journal of Medical Internet Research（IF 8.2）。
